svg.title: Observed Polymarket funding by ISO week
svg.desc: Each row displays separate panels for unique wallets and USD. Horizontal small marks at the baseline denote observed zero. A cross denotes missing evidence. Panels have independent scales.

g.text: Weekly receipts at Polymarket trading addresses
Polygon trading accounts · verified paths and possible source attribution · ISO weeks, UTC
Each panel has its own scale. Baseline dashes = observed zero. × = unknown. USD uses dated quotes. Population coverage is partial.
